_comment: Curated sub-team composition for domains that are too flat as a single 36-agent blob. Each entry under a domain emits ONE teams/<id>.json payload + one registry entry. Member ids must match the `id` field inside src/agency/<domain>/*.json. Tones are limited to the 6 the UI supports: indigo, emerald, sky, rose, amber, violet.

marketing.name: Search & AEO
marketing.focus: organic and AI-engine discoverability — technical SEO, AEO/GEO citations, app-store optimization, and Baidu

marketing.name: Western Social & Community
marketing.focus: English-language social platforms and community growth — LinkedIn, X/Twitter, Instagram, Reddit, and TikTok

marketing.name: China Social & Content
marketing.focus: China's social ecosystem — WeChat, Weibo, Xiaohongshu, Zhihu, Bilibili, Douyin, and Kuaishou

marketing.name: Media & Live Production
marketing.focus: video and audio production, editing, optimization, and livestream commerce

marketing.name: E-Commerce & China Retail
marketing.focus: China and cross-border commerce — Taobao/Tmall/PDD/JD, Amazon/Shopee/Temu, private domain, and go-to-market

marketing.name: Content, Email & PR
marketing.focus: editorial content, CRM email, public relations, growth engineering, and thought-leadership books
